sectionAnalyses.title: 〔第一章〕胖，是一种心病
sectionAnalyses.purpose: 通过小珊从170斤减至101斤的真实案例，论证肥胖的心理根源，建立“减肥是心理战而非单纯技术问题”的核心论点
sectionAnalyses.significance: 确立全书心理学基础，指出减肥失败的根本原因在于未解决的心理与心态问题

sectionAnalyses.title: 〔1〕减肥不是瘦
sectionAnalyses.purpose: 重新定义减肥成功标准，从单纯体重下降转变为食欲、口味偏好、饮食习惯及心态的根本性生活方式改变
sectionAnalyses.significance: 建立“减肥是成为瘦人而非短期变瘦”的核心理念，反对依赖意志力的减肥模式

sectionAnalyses.title: 〔2〕没有减不下来的肥，天底下也只有一种胖
sectionAnalyses.purpose: 驳斥“顽固脂肪”“基础代谢受损”等伪科学观点，确立所有肥胖本质都是热量失衡的统一原理
sectionAnalyses.significance: 消除减肥者的特殊化借口，建立“所有肥胖均可减”的信心与科学认知

sectionAnalyses.title: 〔3〕减肥，不要追求最好的效果，也不要制订减肥目标
sectionAnalyses.purpose: 论证 rigid goal-setting 在减肥中的危害，提倡根据现实条件灵活调整的心理策略
sectionAnalyses.significance: 预防因目标未达成导致的心理崩溃与自暴自弃，建立可持续的弹性减肥观

sectionAnalyses.title: 〔4〕会反弹的减肥才是真正的减肥
sectionAnalyses.purpose: 正常化减肥过程中的体重波动，建立“可控反弹”概念以维持长期减肥动力
sectionAnalyses.significance: 帮助减肥者建立对体重波动的合理预期，防止因短期反弹而放弃整体计划

sectionAnalyses.title: 〔5〕多数减肥平台期是假的平台期
sectionAnalyses.purpose: 解构“减肥平台期”概念，论证多数停滞实为努力程度不足的主观瓶颈而非生理极限
sectionAnalyses.significance: 破除“平台期不可突破”的迷思，激励减肥者通过多维调整（饮食量、活动量、运动）继续进步

sectionAnalyses.title: 〔6〕减肥，不要计算热量
sectionAnalyses.purpose: 通过三个实验论证热量计算的心理学误差与实际操作困难，反对机械热量控制法
sectionAnalyses.significance: 指出主观认知与客观热量摄入的系统性偏差，建议放弃精确计算转向模块化饮食

sectionAnalyses.title: 〔7〕减肥是一件很自私的事
sectionAnalyses.purpose: 强调减肥的个人责任属性，破除寻求捷径与外部依赖的心理
sectionAnalyses.significance: 强化减肥者的主体性与努力必要性，为心篇收尾

sectionAnalyses.title: 〔第二章〕减肥，别只看体重
sectionAnalyses.purpose: 通过小菲案例引入体成分概念，展示体重与体型变化的不一致性，开启测量方法论讨论
sectionAnalyses.significance: 确立“关注体成分而非体重”的第二章核心主题，为科学测量铺垫

sectionAnalyses.title: 〔1〕减肥不等于减体重
sectionAnalyses.purpose: 系统定义体成分构成，区分脂肪减少与体重减少的本质差异
sectionAnalyses.significance: 建立体成分分析的基本概念框架，解释增肌与减脂并行的可能性

sectionAnalyses.title: 〔2〕一天瘦一斤，瘦下去的是什么？
sectionAnalyses.purpose: 揭示快速体重下降的生理本质为糖原、蛋白质与水分流失而非脂肪减少
sectionAnalyses.significance: 科学解释快速减肥的虚假性，建立健康减肥速度的认知基础

sectionAnalyses.title: 〔3〕减肥时体重不变，就是失败吗？
sectionAnalyses.purpose: 论证体重不变情况下仍可能实现减脂（肌肉增加抵消脂肪减少），建立非体重成功标准
sectionAnalyses.significance: 为减肥者提供体重停滞时的心理支撑，区分良性停滞与失败

sectionAnalyses.title: 〔4〕减肥，不看体重看什么？
sectionAnalyses.purpose: 评估BMI等常用指标的局限性，提出体成分与体型观察的替代方案
sectionAnalyses.significance: 提供实用监测指标建议，完成从体重到体成分的范式转换

sectionAnalyses.title: 〔5〕体脂秤能测准你的体成分吗？
sectionAnalyses.purpose: 系统评估生物电阻抗法(BIA)及家用体脂秤的技术局限与误差来源
sectionAnalyses.significance: 破除对家用体脂秤的盲目信任，为推荐皮褶卡尺做铺垫

sectionAnalyses.title: 〔6〕买一把便宜好用的脂肪卡尺
sectionAnalyses.purpose: 推荐皮褶厚度测量法作为经济实用的体成分监测工具，提供操作规范
sectionAnalyses.significance: 提供可操作的低成本监测方案，建立直接测量脂肪变化的实用方法

sectionAnalyses.title: 〔第三章〕快速减肥——折腾人的体重游戏

sectionAnalyses.significance: 开启快速减肥危害的系统论证，确立‘笑到最后才算成功’的长期主义视角

sectionAnalyses.title: 〔1〕为什么快速减肥=快速反弹？
sectionAnalyses.purpose: 定义健康减肥速度标准（每周0.5-1公斤），论证快速减肥的不可持续性与商业欺骗性

sectionAnalyses.title: 〔2〕为什么减肥越快，反弹越快？

sectionAnalyses.title: 〔3〕快速减肥有危险——减肥不能以健康为代价
sectionAnalyses.purpose: 引入快速减肥的健康风险，特别是极低热量饮食导致的死亡案例
sectionAnalyses.significance: 提升快速减肥风险等级至生命安全层面，为后续具体健康危害铺垫

sectionAnalyses.title: 〔4〕快速减肥容易导致女性月经紊乱和骨质疏松
sectionAnalyses.purpose: 详细阐述快速减肥对女性生殖健康与骨骼健康的特定危害

sectionAnalyses.significance: 提供实用的健康保护策略，强调预防优于治疗

sectionAnalyses.title: 〔6〕快速减肥，可能会毁掉你的免疫功能
sectionAnalyses.purpose: 引入快速减肥对免疫系统的负面影响，建立运动-营养-免疫关联
sectionAnalyses.significance: 扩展快速减肥危害至免疫系统，完善健康风险图谱

sectionAnalyses.purpose: 提供免疫系统保护的具体策略：适量运动、营养干预、心理应激管理
sectionAnalyses.significance: 提供可操作的免疫保护方案，强调运动适量与营养补充的重要性

sectionAnalyses.title: 〔9〕只有慢减肥才是真减肥
sectionAnalyses.purpose: 通过小余医生案例总结全章，确立慢减肥作为唯一可持续减肥方式的结论
sectionAnalyses.significance: 收束全章论证，预告后续具体方法（模块化饮食法），确立‘慢即是快’的核心价值观

chapterMaps.summary: 本章是《身篇》的核心实践章节，系统性地介绍了运动减肥和模块化饮食法两大实用框架。前半部分（第四章）详细讲解了三种运动形式（持续性有氧运动、HIIT、力量训练）及NEAT减肥法的原理、操作方法和优缺点，并提供了基于性别和身体状况的运动配比建议。后半部分（第五、六章）阐述了模块化饮食法的完整实施体系，包括热量消耗计算、九大类食材标准化模块、具体食谱搭配方法以及应对减肥平台期的阶段性策略。

chapterMaps.summary: This chapter (titled "Brain Chapter") provides a critical thinking framework for evaluating weight loss information. It first exposes how pseudoscience dominates the weight loss industry through appealing false promises, then explains why personal experience is unreliable due to individual physiological differences and cognitive biases. The chapter establishes scientific evidence—particularly randomized controlled trials and systematic reviews—as the only trustworthy foundation for weight loss decisions.

sectionAnalyses.title: 〔第七章〕全世界都在忽悠你——减肥知识我该信谁？
sectionAnalyses.purpose: Open with statistical evidence of misinformation prevalence and a cautionary tale about dangerous dieting to establish the urgency of information literacy
sectionAnalyses.significance: Establishes the problem: the vast majority of weight loss information is pseudoscientific and potentially harmful

sectionAnalyses.title: 〔1〕减肥，为什么全世界都在忽悠你？
sectionAnalyses.purpose: Explain the psychological and market reasons why pseudoscience thrives—weight loss is genuinely difficult and people prefer comforting false promises over hard scientific realities
sectionAnalyses.significance: Provides the psychological foundation for understanding why false claims are more appealing than scientific truths

sectionAnalyses.title: 〔2〕减肥，为什么好骗？
sectionAnalyses.purpose: Analyze three structural reasons why weight loss is particularly susceptible to scams: focus on weight rather than fat, short-term thinking, and gaps in scientific knowledge
sectionAnalyses.significance: Identifies specific vulnerabilities that scammers exploit in the weight loss market

sectionAnalyses.title: 〔3〕伪科学减肥都是怎么骗人的？
sectionAnalyses.purpose: Catalog six specific rhetorical and logical tactics used by pseudoscience to deceive consumers
sectionAnalyses.significance: Provides pattern recognition tools to identify specific deception strategies

sectionAnalyses.title: 〔4〕如何鉴别伪科学减肥——3个“金标准”
sectionAnalyses.purpose: Provide three practical, actionable criteria for evaluating the credibility of weight loss claims and sources
sectionAnalyses.significance: Delivers the core evaluative framework of the chapter—actionable standards for information verification

sectionAnalyses.title: 〔第八章〕不骗你，我亲身验证——个人经验靠得住吗？
sectionAnalyses.purpose: Transition to examining personal experience as an information source through the parable of the '6 sour dates' weight loss myth
sectionAnalyses.significance: Shifts focus from external misinformation to the unreliability of personal anecdotes and self-experimentation

sectionAnalyses.title: 〔1〕适合别人的不一定适合你
sectionAnalyses.purpose: Systematize the major physiological and demographic differences between individuals that make universal weight loss solutions impossible
sectionAnalyses.significance: Establishes the scientific basis for why one person's success cannot be generalized to others

sectionAnalyses.title: 〔2〕我觉得有用的，不一定真有用
sectionAnalyses.purpose: Demonstrate the complexity of weight loss causality and why self-observation cannot isolate variables effectively
sectionAnalyses.significance: Shows that weight loss involves at least 10 interacting factors, making personal attribution of cause nearly impossible

sectionAnalyses.title: 〔3〕人往往是先去相信，再去找证据
sectionAnalyses.purpose: Explain cognitive biases—particularly confirmation bias and belief perseverance—that corrupt the interpretation of personal experience
sectionAnalyses.significance: Reveals the psychological mechanisms that cause people to misinterpret their own weight loss experiences

sectionAnalyses.title: 〔4〕伪科学是如何利用人们“想当然”的心理的？
sectionAnalyses.purpose: Illustrate how pseudoscience exploits intuitive but incorrect assumptions using the detailed example of protein powder marketing
sectionAnalyses.significance: Concrete demonstration of how marketing exploits the gap between intuitive assumptions (solubility = quality) and scientific reality

sectionAnalyses.title: 〔5〕理解实践是检验真理的唯一标准
sectionAnalyses.purpose: Establish the randomized controlled trial as the gold standard for knowledge and contrast its rigor with the subjectivity of personal experience
sectionAnalyses.significance: Concludes the chapter by defining scientific methodology as the only valid 'practice' for testing weight loss truths
